task: Surface orphaned MLX processes and safely terminate a freshly re-verified orphan from MLX Studio

events.summary: Kept the existing general kill_mlx_process command unchanged; the new termination command independently rescans marker ownership, process liveness, and MLX command line before signaling.

The existing orphan scan exposed detected processes but supplied no orphan-only termination path; the unrelated kill_mlx_process command accepts an arbitrary PID and therefore cannot establish fresh orphan ownership.
Added a fail-closed orphan-only termination path, marker removal only after confirmed exit, and an MLX Studio card that renders scan errors and unreadable markers without claiming an empty scan.
Pure admission tests prove that only a PID in the fresh orphan scan is allowed and that missing or session-tracked PIDs are refused.
events.scope: orphan termination admission decision in src-tauri services/mlx_lifecycle
